commentary: With market breadth deteriorating to a fragile 39% and the deterministic gate pegged at WEAK, disciplined market-direction rules must take precedence. Stan Weinstein taught us never to swim against an unconfirmed tape, while William O'Neil stressed that three out of four stocks follow the market's prevailing undercurrent. Even as headline indices defend support and selective mid-caps build bases, low breadth creates elevated breakout failure risk. Capital preservation is paramount: employ Mark Minervini's progressive exposure, avoid chasing extended names, and enforce tight stop discipline. Only proven Stage 2 market leaders backed by institutional accumulation and genuine earnings acceleration warrant capital deployment.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Trading above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200, resting within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot on 2x volume expansion. However, broader Stage 1 consolidation lacks multi-month institutional accumulation footprints, and relative strength remains muted.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe operational contraction with Q1 revenue tumbling 56.3% YoY and net profit dropping 25.6%. Low ROCE of 5.6% and ROE of 2.8% reflect poor capital efficiency, failing O'Neil CANSLIM fundamental criteria.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis fails on a breakdown below the 92.26 stop; violation of the 50-day average invalidates the setup.

ACE.technical: Constructive double bottom pattern clearing neckline resistance above a rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume tracking at 1.16x average signals orderly accumulation with healthy relative strength across the capital goods space.
ACE.fundamental: Dominant market position in mobile cranes (>60% domestic share). Capital efficiency is excellent with ROCE of 31.6% and ROE of 22.8%, backed by a virtually debt-free balance sheet and expanding operating margins near 20%.
ACE.risk: Thesis fails if price closes below the 1111.18 stop level or breaks under the 50-day SMA.

AEGISLOG.technical: Superb high tight flag consolidation in Stage 2, holding firm above rising 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA. Volume expanded to 2.15x average near the pivot, confirming powerful institutional sponsorship and top-tier relative strength.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exceptional earnings acceleration driven by LPG throughput and liquid terminal expansion. Q1 PAT surged 269% YoY with EBITDA margins expanding to 34.8%. Strong ROCE of 13.3%, ROE of 16.3%, and manageable leverage.
AEGISLOG.risk: Breakdown below the 1376.44 flag support invalidates the setup; execute strict cut if 21 EMA fails.

AMDIND.technical: Double bottom reversal attempting a Stage 2 breakout above key moving averages with a 3.16x volume surge. Momentum oscillator is positive (RSI 67), but long-term overhead resistance from prior distribution ranges remains formidable.
AMDIND.fundamental: Q1 saw a dramatic turnaround in packaging volumes, but full-year FY26 was loss-making. Microcap scale with ROCE of 0.64%, negative 3-year average ROE (-1.5%), and low interest coverage denote speculative fundamentals.
AMDIND.risk: Thesis fails below the 64.10 stop level; failure to hold the 50-day SMA aborts turnaround momentum.

ANANDRATHI.technical: Well-formed double bottom base clearing its neckline pivot comfortably above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Volume running 1.41x average confirms institutional demand, displaying sustained relative strength leadership against broader market chop.
ANANDRATHI.fundamental: High-quality wealth manager delivering continuous EPS and revenue acceleration. Outstanding profitability with ROCE of 57.5% and ROE of 45.3%. Zero debt, robust operating cash flow, and 38%+ net margins fulfill strict CANSLIM standards.
ANANDRATHI.risk: Thesis breaks below the 2168.14 stop; close beneath the rising 50-day SMA requires immediate exit.

ARROWGREEN.technical: Textbook SEPA Stage 2 breakout to new 52-week highs, clearing a 20-session base on an explosive 9.82x volume expansion. Demonstrates elite relative strength and sharp momentum well above all key moving averages.
ARROWGREEN.fundamental: High-tech security products and green packaging drove Q1 PAT up 151% YoY with EBITDA margins exceeding 40%. Virtually debt-free balance sheet with ROCE of 29.6% and ROE of 21.2%, though past quarterly lumpiness persists.
ARROWGREEN.risk: Breakout fails on a close below 800.89; heavy-volume reversal back inside the base requires cutting the position.
